title: 4th generation nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitors: An iterative SAR-guided design, synthesis, and biological evaluation towards picomolar dual binding inhibitors.
authors: Eissa, Ahmed G; Barrow, Denise; Gee, Julia; Powell, Lauren E; Foster, Paul A; Simons, Claire
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芳香化酶抑制剂的设计合成与活性评价，对象为酶-小分子药物互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: One in every eight women will be diagnosed with breast cancer during their lifetime and approximately 70% of all patients are oestrogen receptor (ER) positive depending upon oestrogen for their growth accounting for third generation aromatase (CYP19A1) inhibitors being the mainstay in the treatment of ER-positive breast cancer. Despite the success of current aromatase inhibitors, acquired resistance occurs after prolonged therapy. Although the precise mechanisms of resistance are not known, lack of cross resistance among aromatase inhibitors drives the need for a newer generation of inhibitors to overcome this resistance alongside minimising toxicity and adverse effects. Novel triazole-based inhibitors were designed based on previously published parent compound 5a, making use of the now available crystal structure of CYP19A1 (PDB 3S79), to make modifications at specific sites to explore the potential of dual binding at both the active site and the access channel. Modifications included adding long chain substituents e.g. but-2-ynyloxy and pent-2-ynyloxy at different positions including the most active compound 13h with IC(50) value in the low picomolar range (0.09 nM). Aromatase inhibition results paired with molecular dynamics studies provided a clear structure activity relationship and favourable dual binding mode was verified. Toxicity assays and CYP selectivity profile studies for some example compounds were performed to assess the safety profile of the prepared inhibitors providing the basis for the 4th generation nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 每八名女性中便有一人一生中会被诊断出乳腺癌，约70%的患者为雌激素受体（ER）阳性，其生长依赖雌激素，这使得第三代芳香化酶（CYP19A1）抑制剂成为ER阳性乳腺癌治疗的主要手段。尽管当前芳香化酶抑制剂取得了成功，但长期治疗后会出现获得性耐药。虽然耐药的精确机制尚不清楚，但芳香化酶抑制剂之间缺乏交叉耐药性，促使需要开发新一代抑制剂以克服耐药性，同时最小化毒性和不良反应。基于先前发表的母体化合物5a，利用现已获得的CYP19A1晶体结构（PDB 3S79），设计了新型三唑类抑制剂，在特定位点进行修饰，以探索在活性位点和通道入口处双重结合的可能性。修饰包括在不同位置添加长链取代基，如丁-2-炔氧基和戊-2-炔氧基，其中活性最高的化合物13h的IC(50)值达到低皮摩尔范围（0.09 nM）。芳香化酶抑制结果与分子动力学研究相结合，提供了清晰的结构-活性关系，并验证了有利的双重结合模式。对部分示例化合物进行了毒性测定和CYP选择性谱研究，以评估所制备抑制剂的安全性，为第四代非甾体芳香化酶抑制剂奠定了基础。
